source_status.exact_result: Unverified author proof of the specified-tree conditional analytic construction: over algebraically closed complete nontrivially valued C of any characteristic, for an actual connected rig-smooth strict affinoid curve Z with supplied simply semistable model, metric TREE Gamma, actual Shilov boundary B and retraction tau, every finite real continuous edge-affine F harmonic on Gamma minus B has two ordinary CLD-smooth psh sequences on the entire actual analytic interior of Z, continuous on Z, decreasing uniformly to plus and minus F composed with tau. Thus every supplied compact strict affinoid Y inside that interior has both sequences on precisely the same Y and actual ordinary neighborhood. Arbitrary residual genus and all actual calibrations, directions, whole annular fibres and finite lift exceptions are retained. This is a conditional partial result, not original-scope recognition or the all-curve gate.
concrete_gaps: No derivation of harmonic skeletal factorization for an arbitrary continuous zero-current function is provided; it is an input to this conditional theorem.
No local model or metric-tree realization inside every prescribed ordinary neighborhood of an arbitrary curve is proved. The actual model, tree, affinoid Z and Y are supplied inputs.
The all-curve regularization gate remains open here, including unsupplied models, singular or nonreduced curves and arbitrary ground fields.
Scalar-current ascent is a separate obligation and is not used or proved in this construction. Original arbitrary-dimensional P06.2 remains open; no strict analytic counterexample is constructed.
The conditional theorem is an unverified author draft relying on precisely stated standard foundations. No independent mathematical review or certification was run. P05.2 is untouched.
